caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt-like object composed of a repeating geometric pattern. The primary colors used are a deep blue and a soft pink. The design is arranged in diagonal segments of alternating pink and blue lines, forming squares set on their points. These squares are juxtaposed with areas containing intricate blue linework on the pink background, forming diamond and square motifs with smaller geometric patterns inside them. The entire quilt is outlined with a thin blue border, and the lower right corner is shown folded over, revealing the same pattern and coloration on the reverse side. The background is a plain cream or off-white color with no markings or textures.
title: Piece of a Coverlet - Cobalt Blue & Rose
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
